sloka: न मां त्वमवजानीषे दुःखितामवमानिताम् ।वृक्षस्यावज्ञया ब्रह्मंश्छिद्यन्ते वृक्षजीविनः ।। ७.५८.२० ॥
transliteration: na māṁ tvamavajānīṣe duḥkhitāmavamānitām ।vṛkṣasyāvajñayā brahmaṁśchidyante vṛkṣajīvinaḥ ।। 7.58.20 ॥

translations.english: Indrani complains to Chyavana that Nahusha disregards her, who is distressed and humiliated, just as tree-dwellers are destroyed by disrespecting the tree.
